run_statistic_analysis: run statistical analysis on audio codec quantized latents using a config file and dataset subset
load_analyzer_model: load an AudioDec analyzer model from a checkpoint file for audio latent extraction
analyze_audio_latents: analyze a single audio sample through the encoder projector and quantizer pipeline to get quantized latents
load_audio_dataset: load a dataset of WAV audio files from a specified subset path for processing
compute_scaler_stats: compute and save StandardScaler mean and scale statistics for codec quantized latent representations
